description: Extract structured data from a web page according to a JSON schema. Navigates to the given URL, renders the page in a headless browser, and returns data matching your schema definition. Use this instead of navigate + get_a11y_tree when you need specific structured fields (e.g. product name, price, rating) rather than a full page snapshot. Each key in the schema should map to a CSS selector or description of the data to extract.

schema.description: JSON object defining the fields to extract. Keys are field names, values describe what to extract. Example: {"title": "The main heading", "price": "The product price", "description": "The product description"}.

url.description: Full URL of the page to extract data from (e.g. "https://example.com/product/123")

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before extraction, useful for dynamically-loaded content.

name: extract_schema
